system.summary: Consonant signs with the vowel written as a superscript figure (1-5 = u, o, i, e, a), bare vowel signs, homophones, word signs (F = et, M = non, T = senza) and a numeric nomenclator between points (.2. papa, .4. Cristianissimo, .64. Santita), between clear passages.
system.sibling_key: the cipher/decipherment pairs of the time in the same filza (345/346, 340/341, 342/343)

prior_solution.where: No decipherment of the time for 307, 309, 310, 311 or 322 (Daniel Bourdeau's vetting of 6 Nov 2026; neighbours and the untitled clear copies checked on 9 Nov 2026; 316 is the clear of 315, not of 310); for 333 the same news is given in clear in 332 (copy to the Otto of the same day). Not in Desjardins-Canestrini, Negociations diplomatiques de la France avec la Toscane, vol. II (1861), which has a gap from 16 Aug 1514 to 25 May 1515. Catalogue 2389 open, no target or PR by anyone else in this repository (re-checked 9 Nov 2026).

conditions.human_role: Daniel Bourdeau found the six bare letters and the pairs of the same system (lead 2389). Brice Dudout set the rules (protocols hashed before each held-out transcription, one measurement each, thresholds fixed in advance; transcriptions hashed before decoding). AI agents transcribed, built and merged the keys, measured and read. No human palaeographer checked the transcriptions.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Key v3 learnt from the cipher/decipherment pairs of the time 345/346 and 340/341 in MAP LXXII; frozen before each held-out part.
P01 (346 vs 345): character agreement 0.788, control 0.338; P02 (340 vs 341): 0.691, control 0.341; both under the binary threshold 0.85: not validated.

P03bis on 342 c. 433r first paragraph (247 tokens), Italian n-gram criterion calibrated before transcription: N = 0.613 between the partial (0.004) and validated (0.765) thresholds: partial; the partial threshold is lenient (declared).

Bare letter 322 transcribed (hashed) and decoded with v3 and a derived key v4 (declared, not measured): about 168 cipher words, about 77% read by sense (block 1 about 92%), 0 restored; counts approximate.

Two keys derived from v4 by two agents reading 307/309 (v5a) and 311/333 (v5b) disagreed on two signs; merged into key v6 by a declared arbitration (frozen/ARBITRAGE-v6.md): the word sign α = per (it is the sign written 'P' in the earlier transcriptions; 13 clears of the time read 'per'; of its 25 occurrences in the bare letters none requires 'et'), 4# = ll (333 against the clear 332) and G# = gg are two signs; v6 frozen before the final readings and before the transcription of 310. Declared, not measured.

Bare letters 307, 309, 310, 311 and 333 transcribed (hashed before decoding) and read with key v6: 307 90%, 309 90%, 310 about 75%, 311 about 80-85% (transcription not blind), 333 100% (content known from the clear 332); counts approximate for 310 and 311.

outcome.method: key recovered based on plaintext from external sources
outcome.method_basis: The key was learnt from cipher/decipherment pairs of the time in the same filza, measured on held-out pairs (partial at best), extended by declared derived values (v4, v6), then applied to the bare letters 307, 309, 310, 311, 322 and 333, which have no decipherment.

validation.notes: Contributor's pre-registered held-out tests (not docs/_validate.py): P01 0.788 and P02 0.691 under 0.85 (not validated); P03bis n-gram N 0.613, partial under a lenient threshold. Keys v4 and v6 derived after measurement, not measured.

outcome.fraction_read_source: Words read by sense (certain + probable) over all six bare letters, about 1,740 of about 2,170: 322 about 129/168, 307 262/291, 309 75/83, 310 about 800/1,065 (unresolved groups counted as 3 words), 311 about 440/534, 333 29/29; word boundaries are not written, so the counts are approximate.

credits.note: key rebuilt from the pairs of the time and measured (partial), derived keys v4 and v6 declared; bare letters 322, 307, 309, 310, 311 and 333 transcribed and read (333 read, the others in part)

texts.label: MAP LXXII 322, c. 401r: "Copia di ij cap.li scripti ad Roma sotto di 20 d'octobre" [1514]
texts.summary: After Soliers' recall, an informant (code .51.) says the King will send an ambassador to Rome as soon as Rocciafort arrives, believed to be the bishop of 'Lancres', empowered to negotiate everything with the Pope, and foresees the same quarrel as the Pope's with the bishop of Marseille; after Alfonso Ariosti's visit for Ferrara, the King asked that the Venetian ambassador be approached so that Venice give back Monselice, Este and Montagnana, held by the Este as imperial fiefs.

reading_review.note: block 1 reads as sentences (about 92%), blocks 2 and 3 with real gaps; counts approximate; key partial

texts.label: MAP LXXII 307, c. 369r: copy of Pandolfini's letter to the Otto di Pratica, "de di xvj di febraio M.D.XIIIJ" [16 Feb 1515]
texts.summary: Pandolfini cannot name the Swiss friends of France (secrecy, danger in their cantons); the King's envoy found the Swiss obstinate, offended that he entered without a safe-conduct; the Archduke's embassy led by the count of Nassau presses the marriage of Madame Renee; the renewal of the English accord is expected; the King wants the Italian enterprise 'con grossissime forze', but reason forbids it this year; nothing yet on the truce with Spain.

reading_review.note: 291 words: 205 certain, 57 probable, 29 unresolved (90%); blocks 4 and 5 read as sentences, block 3 with real gaps; key partial

texts.label: MAP LXXII 309, c. 378r: Pandolfini to Lorenzo de' Medici, Paris, 26 Feb 1515, two cipher blocks
texts.summary: As proof of the King's goodwill, Louise of Savoy offered the papal orator a marriage of the Duke of Valentinois's daughter (Louise Borgia) for Lorenzo; the King awaits the Pope's declaration on the newly made league to learn his mind. A Borgia match for Lorenzo is mentioned in the literature; this offer of Feb 1515 is still to be checked in the printed sources.

reading_review.note: 83 words: 59 certain, 16 probable, 8 unresolved (90%); code .48. unresolved; the Borgia offer is to be checked in the literature

texts.label: MAP LXXII 310, cc. 380r-381v: copy of Pandolfini's letter to the Otto di Pratica, Paris, 26 Feb - 2 Mar 1515
texts.summary: La Guiche ('Ghiscia'), the King's ambassador in England, came back to settle the articles and left again; Suffolk says the accord will be made; a Spanish friar-bishop met at Calais goes to England to 'set fire', in vain; the Flemings ask for Madame Renee on dishonest terms; the King has a copy of the league and is satisfied with the Pope; the accord with England will be confirmed, Scotland pending; a Swiss diet plans to attack France; the King considers hiring troops (code .22.); the Catholic King proposes a three-year truce, fearing for Naples and Castile.

reading_review.note: about 75% (701 certain, 109 probable, 85 unresolved groups); three reservations: pos. 759 transcribed not blind, codes .22., 20./23., .uij. unresolved, HD re-reading wanted for blocks C-E; 'Ghiscia' = Pierre de La Guiche confirmed in L&P Henry VIII vol. 2 and TNA E 30/754

texts.label: MAP LXXII 311, cc. 382r-v: continuation of the copy to the Otto (310), "Tenuta adi iiij" [4 Mar 1515]
texts.summary: Rumour of the Duke of Suffolk's marriage to the 'white queen' Mary Tudor; letters from Rome of the 24th say the Pope and Florence joined the new league; Pandolfini asked the King not to believe it, and the King said he would not believe it until he saw it; P.S.: the league would pay 30,000 ducats a month to the Swiss and 30,000 to the Viceroy, shared by the Pope and two members coded .16. and .17.

reading_review.note: about 80-85% (424 certain, 44 probable, 1 restored, 65 unresolved groups); transcription NOT blind (declared); codes .16./.17. unresolved

texts.label: MAP LXXII 333, c. 417r: Pandolfini to Lorenzo de' Medici, Paris, 27 Dec 1514, one cipher block
texts.summary: Little of weight to report from the French court; everything hangs on the decisions to be taken in Rome, awaited with very great suspicion. Content already given in clear by 332 (copy to the Otto of the same day).

reading_review.note: 29 words, 28 certain and 1 probable: every word read; 4# = ll confirmed by the parallel clear 332; the content is not new (332)

outcome.notes: New texts: no decipherment of the time and no edition for 307, 309, 310, 311 and 322; 333 is a new reading of the cipher whose content is known from the clear 332. Key partial (P03bis, lenient criterion, declared); v6 is a declared merge, not measured. No ASF image is included.
